question: Does the Last Lap message award its positive 152-unit lookup value via the stock message consumer?
answer: No. The earlier message-to-stat mapping equals 0xFF, which routes to display only before boost credit.
skip_branch: USA 81:C110..C118: CMP #$FF; BNE reward; JMP $C1A0 display-only
provenance: Original ROM byte reads with per-build structural-island block SHA-256 and #870 checkpoint queue gate
limit: Does not disprove every imaginable independent lap-dependent mechanic; does disprove boost credit via this queued message consumer.
